answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in yarrow, verified in hollow, and juniper names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 23 submissions per epoch. A 100 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
